name: team_planning_set_departure
description: Have a person leave in a scenario of a Team Planning plan, optionally naming the position that backfills them: it carries the budget and the headcount, and the leaver never counts as filling it. In this scenario's step they stay on the map marked as leaving; in the steps after it they are gone and the position stands alone. A leaving date within the step splits its cost: the leaver costs up to that day and the backfill from the day after; without one, the backfill carries the whole step. team_planning_withdraw_departure has them stay. Refused unless the caller is one of the plan's editors.

scenario_id.description: The scenario, or the plan's id for the baseline.

position_id.description: The backfill: a position the scenario has. Leave it out when the seat isn't backfilled.

leaves_on.description: Their last day, within the scenario's period. Leave it out to have them gone for the whole step.
